attchmntText: Prudential Sugar Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Prudential Sugar Corporation Limited approved its Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Statements for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026. The Board also accepted the Auditors’ Review Report on these financial statements. The company operates in the Sugar segment. Financial results indicate a Net Profit after tax of 26.77 Lakhs for the standalone entity and 37.08 Lakhs for the consolidated entity for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the standalone Net Profit was 10.31 Lakhs and the consolidated Net Profit was 109.96 Lakhs. Earnings Per Share for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, stood at 0.08 for standalone and 0.11 for consolidated figures. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.

attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 47 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed herewith Newspaper Publication regarding Meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company Scheduled to be held on Saturday, November 14, 2026 for adoption of Unaudited (Standalone & Consolidated) Financial Results for the 2nd Quarter and Half Year Ended September 30, 2026 along with the Limited Review Report of the Statutory Auditors of the Company. Notice had been published in both Business Standard and Saksham (Local) on November 06, 2026.We request you to take the above information on record and acknowledge receipt of the same.
